assessment.independenceRationale: Official bank page supports identity/current visual use; Finuslugi independently identifies the bank and publishes the vector. Its upstream design authorship is not explicitly stated, so provenance is publisher-hosted original vector rather than a claim of official vector delivery.

variant.basis: Viewed downloaded official raster and rsvg-convert reference of original SVG: upright three separated orange pointed leaf/flame shapes, no accompanying text in candidate. SVG uses #EB6129, concise intentional bezier geometry, no embedded raster or tracing noise. Suitable standalone mark; official raster supports the emblem variant but does not establish exact vector RGB by itself.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Full source and original/final theme pairs retain all three pointed forms, curved contours and two transparent chevron gaps. Actual Desktop output has no clipping or lost detail.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Original narrow upright proportions and placement retained. Complete emblem fits with source clear space. Both themes have strong orange contrast; resized 24/32/48px icon-area diagnostics retain the three-part silhouette and separation. No need to add a circle or shrink further.
